changes.description: Introduced article sharing capabilities and a new guest mode for easier collaboration.
Integrated OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar as new data sources for research articles.
Initial release: RSS, ArXiv, and blog article scraping pipeline
Multi-provider LLM analysis with automatic fallback (Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter)
Admin panel for managing topics, scraper sources, and users
Automatic translation of analyses, tags, and tag groups into configured languages
Knowledge graph visualization with group and article nodes
Telegram notifications on pipeline completion with per-run stats
OpenTelemetry metrics and structured Loki logging across all pipeline stages
Added internationalization support for trace table columns and log dialogs.
GeoIP-based automatic language detection for frontend visitors
